title: White keys and black keys
summary: The black keys come in groups of two and three. That pattern is your map of the keyboard.

steps.title: White key
steps.body:
The long keys at the front are the **white keys**. A full 88-key piano has 52 of them.

**Why it matters:** The first notes you learn by name are all white keys, and many simple tunes use nothing else.

steps.title: Black key
steps.body:
The shorter, raised keys are the **black keys**. They sit in **groups of two** and **groups of three**, over and over, all the way up the keyboard.

**Why it matters:** The groups of two and three are your map. Every key gets its name from where it sits next to these groups, so once you can spot them you can find anything.

steps.title: The pattern repeats
steps.body: Two black keys, then three, then two again. The same pattern runs along the whole keyboard.

items.prompt: Play the lit black key, in a group of two.
Play the lit black key, in a group of three.

steps.title: Feel the groups
steps.body: Play only the black keys for a while, in any order. Feel the groups of two and three under your fingers without looking.
